data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'graeos', meaning 'grey' or 'gray'. In Greek mythology, the Graeae were three sister witches who possessed the knowledge of all things. The name Grae carries the meaning “Grey or gray” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Grae usually hope their child will grow to embody grey or gray and live with faith, good character and purpose.
